operations.name: PICK
requires: nothing is on top of the object
the object's pose is verified and reachable
no collision risk is reported for the object

operations.name: PLACE
operations.does: put the held object on a zone or on another object
requires: destination is a zone with a free ground pose, or an object with a flat top and nothing on it
result: the object rests on the destination

operations.name: MOVE_TO_TEMPORARY_LOCATION
operations.does: put the held object on a free temporary slot
result: the object rests on the slot

operations.name: REQUEST_NEW_VIEW
operations.does: take an image with the external camera and re-identify the target

operations.name: CHANGE_VIEWPOINT
operations.does: move the wrist camera to see an occluded target

operations.name: VERIFY_SCENE
operations.does: observe again and send the full scene

operations.name: RETRY_ACTION
operations.does: repeat the step that just failed

rules: One object is moved at a time.
Only an object with nothing on top of it can be picked.
Nothing can be placed on a prism.
Temporary placements use the free slots the laptop reports, or free table space (destination 'table') when the scene allows it.
A zone holds as many stacks as its capacity; a free slot holds one object.
An object stacked on something inside a zone counts as being in that zone.
Objects that are unidentified, unreachable or have an unverified pose are not moved, and nothing below them is moved.

goal_vocabulary.meaning: every object ends in the zone of its own colour
the object ends in that zone (on its floor or stacked inside it)
the object rests directly on top of the other object
the object stands alone on a free slot
a tower in this order, BOTTOM FIRST ('red on blue' is [blue, red]); for simple pairs prefer the 'on' form
the object must no longer rest directly on that object ("take a off b")

form.reverse: <id of any object in the stack, or 'all'>

goal_vocabulary.meaning: turn that stack upside down (reverse, flip, invert); the server computes the result from the current arrangement
the two objects change places (swap, exchange, switch); the server computes the result

constraint_vocabulary.meaning: do not park objects on free slots / on the table
these objects must not be moved

never_on: <object id, zone id, slot id, or one of: slot, zone, object>

constraint_vocabulary.meaning: never place the first on the second, not even temporarily
no stack may get higher than this many objects
these objects are moved before anything else, in this order ("first move X", "start with X")
